record.sub: Admit customers and participants · Issue or redeem a claim
kv: NYDFS requires a covered issuer policy to confer a timely par-redemption right on a lawful holder, subject to reasonable conditions including successful onboarding.
A lawful holder requests direct redemption from a DFS-supervised issuer.
Circle Internet Financial, LLC (registered or chartered)
DFS-supervised issuers and authorized onboarding agents applying the covered product redemption policy

The particular coin is issued under DFS supervision and applicable issuer policy applies. Holder/designee successfully onboards and meets compliant-order conditions. Issuer has required DFS approval and current product terms.
Circle is issuer-context only, never the holder. Guidance does not prove that a particular Circle holder has direct redemption rights under current terms.
Circle Internet Financial, LLC: NYDFS lists virtual-currency and money-transmitter licenses.
